extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF/OA package Table 6, Fig 1/Fig 2 context, and cytotoxicity tables; no unsupported intracellular target was inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Vesicle permeabilization data support differential interaction of tested AMPs with bacterial-mimic versus erythrocyte-mimic membranes; citrus-amp1 and Tritrpticin favor the bacterial-mimic vesicles, while Ocellatin4-analogue and Hylin-a1 favor erythrocyte-mimic vesicles.
direct_assay_types: vesicle permeabilization assay with POPC/POPG and POPC model membranes
mechanism_claims.evidence_notes: Table 6 reports maximum vesicle permeabilization for bacterial-mimic 80% POPC/20% POPG and erythrocyte-mimic 100% POPC vesicles at peptide-specific concentrations.
mechanism_claims.strength_notes: Direct biophysical membrane-context evidence; it supports membrane interaction/permeabilization, not a unique pore architecture or intracellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary sequence/property tables and helical-wheel figures support an amphipathic cationic peptide context, but this remains mechanism context unless paired with the vesicle permeabilization assay.
mechanism_claims.evidence_notes: Sequence, molecular-weight, charge, hydrophobicity, hydrophobic moment and helical-wheel evidence define candidate AMP context.
mechanism_claims.strength_notes: Contextual structure-property evidence only; no intracellular molecular target is demonstrated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Detached-leaf X. citri::GFP and CFU recovery results are efficacy context, not a direct molecular mechanism; final mechanism interpretation is therefore bounded to membrane interaction/permeabilization evidence.
mechanism_claims.evidence_notes: The paper reports qualitative fluorescence/canker symptom assessment and CFU recovery after detached-leaf inoculation.
mechanism_claims.strength_notes: Supports plant-pathogen efficacy context but does not identify a specific molecular mechanism.
